breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a Knudsen number of 5 is not in the continuum regime and therefore the Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip walls are invalid. It correctly replaced this flawed instruction with the appropriate modeling approach for this flow regime (a kinetic method like DSMC) and a suitable boundary condition (diffuse reflection), which aligns with the ground truth's correction.
